profile.headline: Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime @ Lattice Compute

posts.text: We just shipped CUDA context snapshotting to every region: p50 cold start is now 1.9s for 70B models. Writeup in comments.
My team is hiring a Senior Systems Engineer (CUDA + Rust). DM me if you like making GPUs boot faster.

news.title: Lattice Compute opens two EU GPU regions for low-latency inference
